demographic_questions.description:
Affirm is dedicated to building an inclusive culture where Affirmers belong and have an equal opportunity to thrive.

To help us assess our outreach efforts, we invite candidates to voluntarily share information through a short demographic survey. This information is:

  • Completely optional
  • Anonymized and stored in aggregate
  • Not accessible to recruiters or hiring managers at the individual level
  • Never used in any hiring decision

Your decision to provide or withhold this information will not impact your candidacy in any way.
